author: in2forex
text:
Hi Hoshiraki

Welcome!! I don't think the 3Drive you marked on your chart is a good one. We normally like to try find a 3Drive moving up into Supply OR down into Demand. Your 3D is a bit in the middle of nowhere.

I have marked a 3D that I see on your chart. Look to the left and you will see that this 3Drive was driving down into demand, before it reacted to that Demand. Keep looking for them the more you mark up charts and practice the easier it becomes.

I2F

author: Torosar
text:
Anybody traded this? Clear compression and 3Drive. But the supplylevel is unclear...

My question is after the breakdown of the previous level there was no retest so how were we to know price wouldn't just race thru to the true supply?

author: kkb
text:
Hi! Great catch of the 3drive!

According to your question: Redsword and masters on this forum often says: "only PA will show you where there is a real supply or demand". And you chart is a prefect instance of these words. You have a level of interests (supply) and PA (3 drive) which shown that your level is a good supply:) Of course this is a M15 chart. So your target should be the nearest flag on this TF (IF's words readthemarket.com/index.php/price-reading ) which was hit.

Also quoting IF: you should be always aware of possible FO into level above (or below in demand) (again your chart is a great example of this because there are two good looking supply levels quite near).

Sorry if I write things that you have already know:P

author: Torosar
text: That is just the thing... The true supply was within reach just above and a possibility of a fakeout is very real. If I were to enter on that 3drive my risk-reward would at best be 1:1. We know that price action validates the level but would the pro traders here take such trades with low risk-reward? BTW: 2 days wiser and indeed touching the true supply got us a great reaction to the downside.
